Rug Cleaning Simulator

Does Rug Cleaning Simulator use AI? Yes. According to the developer's AI disclosure on Steam, AI was used for the art and the writing in Rug Cleaning Simulator. The game costs $12.74 and runs on Windows and Linux.

Listed on GenPlay 29 Oct 2026 · source: Steam

View on Steam

In the developer's words

Turn filthy rugs into spotless transformations in a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Take on customer jobs, clean rugs step by step, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and grow your own rug-cleaning business.From the game's page on Steam

Questions about Rug Cleaning Simulator

What did AI make in Rug Cleaning Simulator?

The developer lists the art and the writing. In their own words: “AI was used for some translations and some visual assets (textures, images, models). The game does not create AI-generated content during gameplay.”

Is Rug Cleaning Simulator free?

Rug Cleaning Simulator costs $12.74 on Steam.

Where can I play Rug Cleaning Simulator?

On Steam. It runs on Windows and Linux.
